message.content:
Below is a **complete list of the Canadian public holidays that create long‑weekends in 2023** (i.e., the holiday falls on a Friday, a Monday, or is observed on a Monday when it lands on a weekend).  
I’ve included the date, the day of the week, whether it produces a long‑weekend, and a short note about the observation rule.  

> **Note:**  
> • The table covers the *national* holidays that apply to all provinces.  
> • Many provinces have additional holidays (e.g., Family Day, St. Patricks’ Day, etc.) that also create long‑weekends in those jurisdictions.  
> • If you need province‑specific data, let me know and I can generate a separate list for each province.

---

### National Long‑Weekend Holidays – 2023

| Date | Holiday | Day of Week | Long‑Weekend? | Observation Rule / Notes |
|------|---------|-------------|---------------|--------------------------|
| **Jan 1** | New Year’s Day | Sunday | ✔ | Observed on Monday, Jan 2 |
| **Feb 20** | Family Day (Alberta, Saskatchewan, Ontario, etc.) | Monday | ✔ | Only in provinces that observe Family Day |
| **Apr 7** | Good Friday | Friday | ✔ | (No statutory holiday in all provinces, but widely observed) |
| **May 22** | Victoria Day | Monday | ✔ | Observed on the Monday preceding May 25 |
| **Jul 1** | Canada Day | Saturday | ✔ | Observed on Monday, Jul 3 |
| **Sep 4** | Labour Day | Monday | ✔ | First Monday in September |
| **Oct 9** | Thanksgiving | Monday | ✔ | Second Monday in October |
| **Nov 11** | Remembrance Day | Saturday | ✔ | Observed on Monday, Nov 13 |
| **Dec 23** | Christmas Eve (observed in some provinces) | Saturday | ✖ | Not a statutory holiday nationwide |
| **Dec 25** | Christmas Day | Monday | ✔ | |
| **Dec 26** | Boxing Day | Tuesday | ✖ | Not a statutory holiday nationwide |

> **Long‑weekend definition**  
> A holiday that gives you at least **three consecutive days off** (Friday‑Saturday‑Sunday or Friday‑Saturday‑Sunday‑Monday).  
> For example, New Year’s Day (Sunday) + observed Monday = 3‑day weekend.

---

### Quick‑Reference JSON (for API integration)

```json
[
  {
    "holiday": "New Year's Day",
    "date": "2023-01-01",
    "day_of_week": "Sunday",
    "long_weekend": true,
    "observation": "Observed on Monday, 2023-01-02"
  },
  {
    "holiday": "Family Day",
    "date": "2023-02-20",
    "day_of_week": "Monday",
    "long_weekend": true,
    "province_specific": true,
    "note": "Observed in Alberta, Saskatchewan, Ontario, etc."
  },
  {
    "holiday": "Good Friday",
    "date": "2023-04-07",
    "day_of_week": "Friday",
    "long_weekend": true,
    "note": "Widely observed but not statutory in all provinces"
  },
  {
    "holiday": "Victoria Day",
    "date": "2023-05-22",
    "day_of_week": "Monday",
    "long_weekend": true,
    "note": "Observed on the Monday preceding May 25"
  },
  {
    "holiday": "Canada Day",
    "date": "2023-07-01",
    "day_of_week": "Saturday",
    "long_weekend": true,
    "observation": "Observed on Monday, 2023-07-03"
  },
  {
    "holiday": "Labour Day",
    "date": "2023-09-04",
    "day_of_week": "Monday",
    "long_weekend": true,
    "note": "First Monday in September"
  },
  {
    "holiday": "Thanksgiving",
    "date": "2023-10-09",
    "day_of_week": "Monday",
    "long_weekend": true,
    "note": "Second Monday in October"
  },
  {
    "holiday": "Remembrance Day",
    "date": "2023-11-11",
    "day_of_week": "Saturday",
    "long_weekend": true,
    "observation": "Observed on Monday, 2023-11-13"
  },
  {
    "holiday": "Christmas Day",
    "date": "2023-12-25",
    "day_of_week": "Monday",
    "long_weekend": true,
    "note": "National holiday"
  }
]
```

---

### How to Use This Data

1. **Embed the JSON** directly into your holiday‑planning app’s data store.  
2. **Filter by `long_weekend:true`** to show only the dates that give you a 3‑day break.  
3. **Add province‑specific logic** if you want to display Family Day only for users in Alberta, Saskatchewan, Ontario, etc.  
4. **Schedule trips** around these dates—most people take the adjacent weekend days off, so you’ll have a 4‑day break for many of them.

---

#### Quick Tips for Your App

| Feature | Implementation Idea |
|---------|----------------------|
| **Calendar View** | Highlight long‑weekend dates in a different color. |
| **User Preferences** | Let users select their province to filter province‑specific holidays. |
| **Travel Deals** | Trigger notifications for special travel packages around long‑weekends. |
| **Reminders** | Auto‑schedule reminders a week before each long‑weekend. |

Let me know if you’d like province‑specific holiday lists or any other customization!
